info.title: Learning Management System API
info.description:
# LMS API Documentation

This is the public API documentation intended for tenants (project owners) and end-users.
Only high-level auth methods are shown — internal implementation details are intentionally omitted.

## Authentication (public-facing)

- **API Key (Project Owner)** Programmatic access for project owners. Send API keys in the Authorization header as:  
  `Authorization: Bearer lms_xxxxxxxxxxxxx`.

- **Managed User (JWT)** End-users (managed by a project) authenticate using JWTs in the Authorization header:  
  `Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`.

- **Delegated Auth (External Systems)** For projects configured to accept delegated logins, external systems may provide an external user id header (e.g. `X-User-Id`) together with a valid project API key.

## Project access patterns

Some endpoints accept either a Project API Key (recommended for programmatic/owner access) or a Managed User JWT (for end-user actions) depending on the operation.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Project API key. Use header: Authorization: Bearer lms_xxxxxxxxxxxxx

ManagedUserAuth.description: JWT token for managed end-users. Use header: Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>

DelegatedAuth.name: X-User-Id
DelegatedAuth.description: External user id for delegated authentication. Typically used together with a project API key.
